description: This Java class 'DefaultThrottlingConfig' implements the 'ThrottlingConfig' interface, providing configuration details related to throttling such as interval and limit. It reads configuration values from an external config source, ensures immutability, and provides standard object methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultThrottlingConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of ThrottlingConfig that encapsulates throttling interval and limit.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultThrottlingConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the throttling limit as an integer.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on interval and limit.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on interval and limit.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the config object.
